scope: Certified ceiling for ALL continuous strictly increasing odd light-coordinate warps of the archived 338-path Princess law. Restricted family only; NOT the full game value.
statement: For every continuous strictly increasing psi with psi(-z)=-psi(z), psi(z+2)=psi(z)+2, the pushforward Princess law of the archived 338 paths has inf_M E T(M,P_psi) <= exact_worst_step. Same ceiling holds for limits of such pushforwards. Proof uses transformed physical Monster routes, not 16-knot sampling.
discovery: Double-precision LP over 94 exact step cells used only to propose weights. Integer-normalized weights and the complete 75-breakpoint BigInt envelope are the proof; no LP optimality is claimed.
